In the aesthetic and hair-restoration treatment, there are many types of PRP, although scientifically they often fall into a few basic categories. 

1. Standard PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma)
Prepared by centrifuging blood to concentrate platelets.
Most common for hair loss & skin rejuvenation.

2. Double-Spin PRP
High-concentration PRP."
Commonly used in hair restoration.
ProvideS higher growth factor levels than single-spin PRP.

3. Leukocyte-Rich PRP (L-PRP)
Used in orthopedics.

4. Leukocyte-Poor PRP (LP-PRP)
Preferred for facial rejuvenation & hair treatments.

5. Activated PRP
Activator is added before injection.
Causes immediate release of growth factors.
It is also called as growth-factor PRP.

6. Growth Factor Concentrate (GFC)
Popular in India.
Directly releases growth factors.
Contains concentrated growth factors.
It is superior to PRP.

7. PRFM (Platelet-Rich Fibrin Matrix)
Brands include Selphyl & TruPRP.
Creates a fibrin scaffold that slowly releases growth factors.
It is "next-generation PRP."

8. i-PRF
Popular in regenerative aesthetics & dentistry.
Provides prolonged growth factor release.

9. A-PRF (Advanced Platelet-Rich Fibrin)

10. C-PRF (Concentrated PRF)
Higher concentration of platelets and fibrin.

11. Stem Cell PRP
PRP mixed with:
    Exosomes
    SVF 
    Nanofat
    Bone marrow concentrate

12. Exosome-Enhanced PRP
PRP combined with exosomes.
It is an advanced regenerative therapy.

standard PRP with microneedling.
